library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(magrittr)
library(pROC)
library(tibble)

source("../../00-constants.R")






# 5.1. Import metadata & predictions


patient_info_with_folds <- read.csv(
  file.path(gene_data_dir, "metadata_df_with_folds.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F
)

# All prediction files
classifier_files <- tibble(
  classifier = c(
    "Full LASSO",
    "3-feature LASSO",
    "1-feature LASSO",
    "FABP4",
    "ISG15"
  ),
  csv = c(
    "lassoRF_preds.csv",
    "lassoRF_preds_n3.csv",
    "lassoRF_preds_n1.csv",
    "lassoRF_preds_FABP4.csv",
    "lassoRF_preds_ISG15.csv"
  ),
  suffix = c(
    "",
    "n3",
    "n1",
    "FABP4",
    "ISG15"
  )
)

# Import all five prediction files
pred_list <- classifier_files %>%
  mutate(
    preds = lapply(csv, function(f) {
      read.csv(
        file.path(gene_results_dir, f),
        stringsAsFactors=F
      ) %>%
        mutate(
          LRTI_adjudication = factor(
            LRTI_adjudication,
            levels = c("No Evidence", "Definite")
          )
        ) %>%
        inner_join(
          patient_info_with_folds %>%
            select(sample_name, fold),
          by = "sample_name"
        )
    })
  )






# 5.2. AUC helper function


output_auc_roc <- function(preds_df, output_suffix) {

  # Per-fold AUC
  auc_df <- preds_df %>%
    group_by(fold) %>%
    summarize({
      roc_obj <- pROC::roc(
        response = factor(
          LRTI_adjudication,
          levels = c("No Evidence", "Definite")
        ),
        predictor = pred,
        direction = "<"
      )

      ci_vals <- pROC::ci.auc(roc_obj)

      tibble(
        auc = as.numeric(roc_obj$auc),
        auc_lower = ci_vals[1],
        auc_upper = ci_vals[3]
      )
    }, .groups = "drop")

  # Save per-fold AUC
  write.csv(
    auc_df,
    file.path(gene_results_dir,
      paste0("cv_auc", ifelse(
        output_suffix == "", "", 
        paste0("_", output_suffix)),".csv")),
    row.names=F
  )

  # Pooled ROC
  pooled_roc <- pROC::roc(
    response = factor(
      preds_df$LRTI_adjudication,
      levels = c("No Evidence", "Definite")
    ),
    predictor = preds_df$pred,
    direction = "<"
  )

  # Pooled DeLong 95% CI
  ci_auc <- pROC::ci.auc(pooled_roc)

  pooled_summary <- data.frame(
    auc   = as.numeric(ci_auc[2]),
    lower = ci_auc[1],
    upper = ci_auc[3]
  )

  # Save pooled AUC
  write.csv(
    pooled_summary,
    file.path(gene_results_dir,
      paste0("pooled_auc", ifelse(
        output_suffix == "", "", 
        paste0("_", output_suffix)), ".csv")),
    row.names=F
  )

  list(
    fold_auc = auc_df,
    pooled = pooled_summary
  )
}






# 5.3. Run all five classifiers


auc_results <- pred_list %>%
  mutate(
    results = Map(
      output_auc_roc,
      preds,
      suffix
    )
  )

# Full LASSO objects retained for downstream sections
merged_preds <- pred_list$preds[[1]]

auc_lassoRF <- auc_results$results[[1]]$fold_auc

# Print full LASSO AUC
print(auc_lassoRF)






# 5.4. Full LASSO summary


ci_auc <- read.csv(
  file.path(gene_results_dir, "pooled_auc.csv")
)

message(
  "Full LASSO AUC: ",
  round(ci_auc$auc, 2),
  " (95% CI: ",
  round(ci_auc$lower, 2),
  "–",
  round(ci_auc$upper, 2),
  ")"
)






# 5.5. Forest plots


# 5.5a. Forest plot gene + protein data


# Forest plot gene data

forest_data_gene <- auc_results %>%
  transmute(
    classifier,
    auc   = sapply(results, function(x) x$pooled$auc),
    lower = sapply(results, function(x) x$pooled$lower),
    upper = sapply(results, function(x) x$pooled$upper)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    classifier = factor(
      classifier,
      levels = c(
        "ISG15",
        "FABP4",
        "1-feature LASSO",
        "3-feature LASSO",
        "Full LASSO"
      )
    )
  )

write.csv(
  forest_data_gene,
  file.path(gene_results_dir, "forest_data_gene_classifiers.csv"),
  row.names=F
)


# Forest plot protein data

forest_data_prot <- read.csv(
  file.path(prot_results_dir, "forest_data_protein_classifiers.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F
) %>%
  filter(classifier != "1-feature LASSO") %>%
  mutate(workflow = "Protein")

# Prepare gene data
forest_data_gene_combined <- forest_data_gene %>%
  filter(classifier != "1-feature LASSO") %>%
  mutate(workflow = "Gene")


# Combine gene + protein

forest_data_combined <- bind_rows(
  forest_data_gene_combined,
  forest_data_prot
) %>%
  mutate(
    classifier = factor(
      classifier,
      levels = c(
        "ISG15",
        "FABP4",
        "3-feature LASSO",
        "Full LASSO"
      )
    ),
    workflow = factor(
      workflow,
      levels = c("Protein", "Gene")
    )
  )

# Set vertical positions for classifier groups
forest_data_combined <- forest_data_combined %>%
  mutate(
    y_position = case_when(
      classifier == "ISG15" ~ 1.3,
      classifier == "FABP4" ~ 1.9,
      classifier == "3-feature LASSO" ~ 2.5,
      classifier == "Full LASSO" ~ 3.1
    ),
    y_position_dodged = y_position +
      ifelse(workflow == "Gene", 0.10, -0.10)
  )






# 5.5b. Forest Plot – Gene + Protein Classifiers


forest_plot_combined <- ggplot(
  forest_data_combined,
  aes(y = y_position_dodged, color = workflow)
  ) +

  geom_point(
    aes(x = auc),
    size = 3.5
  ) +

  geom_errorbarh(

  ) +

  geom_text(
    aes(

      y = y_position_dodged,

        upper
      )
    ),
    color = ifelse(
    forest_data_combined$workflow == "Gene",

    ),

  ) +

  scale_color_manual(

      "Gene" = gene_color,
      "Protein" = protein_color
    ),
    name = NULL,
    breaks = c("Gene", "Protein")
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0.64, 1.04),
    breaks = seq(0.7, 1.0, 0.1),

  ) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = c(1.3, 1.9, 2.5, 3.1),
    labels = c(
      "ISG15",
      "FABP4",

    title = "Classifier performance summary",

  ) +

    base_family = "Arial"

  theme(

    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(

    ),

# Export as PDF
ggsave(
  file.path(plots_dir, "(4A)_forest_plot_gene_protein_combined.pdf"),
  forest_plot_combined,
  width = 6.5,

# Save plot object for patchwork
saveRDS(

write.csv(

# 5.7. Gene vs protein ROC curves for individual biomarkers


# 5.7a. Prepare data for ROC plots


# Function to create gene vs protein ROC plot
make_biomarker_roc_plot <- function(
  biomarker_name,
  gene_file,
  protein_file,
  output_file
) {

  # Read gene predictions
  gene_preds <- read.csv(
    file.path(gene_results_dir, gene_file),
    stringsAsFactors=F
  )

  # Read protein predictions
  protein_preds <- read.csv(
    file.path(prot_results_dir, protein_file),
    stringsAsFactors=F
  )

  # Ensure consistent factor levels
  gene_preds$LRTI_adjudication <- factor(
    gene_preds$LRTI_adjudication,
    levels = c("No Evidence", "Definite")
  )

  protein_preds$LRTI_adjudication <- factor(
    protein_preds$LRTI_adjudication,
    levels = c("No Evidence", "Definite")
  )


  # Compute ROC objects
  roc_gene <- pROC::roc(
    response = gene_preds$LRTI_adjudication,
    predictor = gene_preds$pred,
    direction = "<",
    ci = TRUE
  )

  roc_protein <- pROC::roc(
    response = protein_preds$LRTI_adjudication,
    predictor = protein_preds$pred,
    direction = "<",
    ci = TRUE
  )
  

  # Prepare ROC data frames
  roc_gene_df <- data.frame(
    specificity = roc_gene$specificities,
    sensitivity = roc_gene$sensitivities,
    classifier = "Gene"
  ) %>%
    arrange(specificity, sensitivity)

  roc_protein_df <- data.frame(
    specificity = roc_protein$specificities,
    sensitivity = roc_protein$sensitivities,
    classifier = "Protein"
  ) %>%
    arrange(specificity, sensitivity)

  roc_combined <- bind_rows(
    roc_gene_df,
    roc_protein_df
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      classifier = factor(
        classifier,
        levels = c("Gene", "Protein")
      )
    )


  # Prepare confidence interval data
  ci_gene <- pROC::ci.se(
    roc_gene,
    specificities = seq(0, 1, 0.01)
  )

  ci_protein <- pROC::ci.se(
    roc_protein,
    specificities = seq(0, 1, 0.01)
  )


  ci_gene_df <- data.frame(
    specificity       = as.numeric(rownames(ci_gene)),
    sensitivity_lower = ci_gene[, 1],
    sensitivity_upper = ci_gene[, 3],
    classifier        = "Gene"
  ) %>%
    arrange(specificity)

  ci_protein_df <- data.frame(
    specificity       = as.numeric(rownames(ci_protein)),
    sensitivity_lower = ci_protein[, 1],
    sensitivity_upper = ci_protein[, 3],
    classifier        = "Protein"
  ) %>%
    arrange(specificity)

  ci_combined <- bind_rows(
    ci_gene_df,
    ci_protein_df
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      classifier = factor(
        classifier,
        levels = c("Gene", "Protein")
      )
    )


  # Pooled AUC values and 95% CIs
  auc_ci_gene    <- pROC::ci.auc(roc_gene)
  auc_ci_protein <- pROC::ci.auc(roc_protein)


  # DeLong test 
  delong_test <- pROC::roc.test(
    roc_gene,
    roc_protein,
    method = "delong"
  )


  # Legend labels
  classifier_labels <- c(
    "Gene" = sprintf(
      "Gene: AUC = %.2f (%.2f\u2013%.2f)",
      auc_ci_gene[2],
      auc_ci_gene[1],
      auc_ci_gene[3]
    ),
    "Protein" = sprintf(
      "Protein: AUC = %.2f (%.2f\u2013%.2f)",
      auc_ci_protein[2],
      auc_ci_protein[1],
      auc_ci_protein[3]
    )
  )


  
  
  
  
# 5.7b. Create ROC plot
  
  
  roc_plot <- ggplot() +

    # Diagonal reference line
    geom_abline(
      intercept = 1,
      slope = -1,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "grey80",
      linewidth = 0.8,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +

    # Confidence interval ribbons
    geom_ribbon(
      data = ci_combined,
      aes(
        x = specificity,
        ymin = sensitivity_lower,
        ymax = sensitivity_upper,
        fill = classifier,
        group = classifier
      ),
      alpha = 0.12
    ) +

    # ROC curves
    geom_line(
      data = roc_combined,
      aes(
        x = specificity,
        y = sensitivity,
        color = classifier,
        group = classifier
      ),
      linewidth = 1
    ) +

    geom_point(
      data = data.frame(
        specificity = 0,
        sensitivity = 0,
        classifier = factor(
          "DeLong",
          levels = c("Gene", "Protein", "DeLong")
        )
      ),
      aes(
        x = specificity,
        y = sensitivity,
        color = classifier
      ),
      alpha = 0
    ) +

    # Axes
    scale_x_reverse(
      breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2),
      labels = sprintf("%.1f", seq(0, 1, 0.2))
    ) +

    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2),
      limits = c(0, 1)
    ) +

    # Colors
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Gene"    = gene_color,
        "Protein" = protein_color
      ),
      labels = classifier_labels,
      name = NULL,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +

    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "Gene" = gene_color,
        "Protein" = protein_color
      ),
      name = NULL,
      guide = "none"
    ) +

    coord_fixed() +

    # Labels
    labs(
      title = paste0(biomarker_name, " classifiers"),
      x = "Specificity",
      y = "Sensitivity"
    ) +

    # Theme
    theme_classic(
      base_family = "Arial"
    ) +

    theme(
      text = element_text(
        family = "Arial",
        size = 12,
        face = "plain"
      ),
      axis.text = element_text(
        family = "Arial",
        size = 16,
        color = "black"
      ),
      axis.title = element_text(
        family = "Arial",
        size = 16,
        face = "plain"
      ),
      plot.title = element_text(
        family = "Arial",
        size = 16,
        face = "plain",
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      legend.text = element_text(
        family = "Arial",
        size = 16,
        face = "plain"
      ),
      legend.key.size = unit(1.2, "lines"),
      legend.position = c(0.50, 0.18),
      legend.background = element_rect(
        fill = "white",
        color = NA
      )
    )


  # Export as PDF
  ggsave(
    file.path(plots_dir, output_file),
    roc_plot,
    width = 6.5,
    height = 6.5,
    device = cairo_pdf,
    bg = "white"
  )


  # Print AUC summaries
  message(
    biomarker_name,
    " Gene AUC: ",
    round(auc_ci_gene[2], 2),
    " (95% CI: ",
    round(auc_ci_gene[1], 2),
    "\u2013",
    round(auc_ci_gene[3], 2),
    ")"
  )

  message(
    biomarker_name,
    " Protein AUC: ",
    round(auc_ci_protein[2], 2),
    " (95% CI: ",
    round(auc_ci_protein[1], 2),
    "\u2013",
    round(auc_ci_protein[3], 2),
    ")"
  )

  message(
    biomarker_name,
    " Gene vs Protein DeLong p-value: ",
    signif(delong_test$p.value, 3)
  )


  # Return results
  invisible(
    list(
      roc_plot    = roc_plot,
      roc_gene    = roc_gene,
      roc_protein = roc_protein,
      auc_gene    = auc_ci_gene,
      auc_protein = auc_ci_protein,
      delong      = delong_test
    )
  )
}






# 5.7c. FABP4: gene vs protein


results_FABP4 <- make_biomarker_roc_plot(

# 5.8. Gene / Protein adjudication plots


# 5.8a. Prepare data for plot


# Function to make gene vs protein prediction-shift plot

make_switch_plot <- function(
    classifier_name,
    gene_filename,
    output_filename
) {

  # Read gene predictions
  gene_preds <- read.csv(
    file.path(gene_results_dir, gene_filename),
    stringsAsFactors=F
  ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      sample_name,
      LRTI_adjudication,
      pred_gene = pred
    )

  # Read protein predictions
  prot_preds <- read.csv(
    file.path(prot_results_dir, gene_filename),
    stringsAsFactors=F
  ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      patient_id,
      pred_prot = pred
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      patient_id = as.character(patient_id)
    )


  # Use metadata to connect gene sample_name to protein patient_id
  combined_preds <- gene_preds %>%
    left_join(
      metadata_df_with_folds %>%
        dplyr::select(
          sample_name,
          patient_id
        ) %>%
        mutate(
          patient_id = as.character(patient_id)
        ),
      by = "sample_name"
    ) %>%
    inner_join(
      prot_preds,
      by = "patient_id"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      switched = (pred_gene >= 0.5) != (pred_prot >= 0.5),
      LRTI_adjudication = factor(
        LRTI_adjudication,
        levels = c("Definite", "No Evidence")
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      sample_name,
      patient_id,
      LRTI_adjudication,
      pred_gene,
      pred_prot,
      switched
    )


  # Check that matching worked
  message(
    classifier_name,
    ": ",
    nrow(combined_preds),
    " matched patients"
  )

  message(
    classifier_name,
    ": ",
    sum(combined_preds$switched),
    " switched patients"
  )

  # Facet labels
  facet_labels <- c(
    "Definite" = "LRTI",
    "No Evidence" = "Control"
  )

  
  
  
  
  
# 5.8b. Prediction shift plot
  
  
  pred_shift_plot <- ggplot(combined_preds) +

    # Non-switcher lines
    geom_segment(
      data = combined_preds %>%
        filter(!switched),
      aes(
        x = 1,
        xend = 2,
        y = pred_gene,
        yend = pred_prot
      ),
      color = "grey88",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +

    # Switcher lines
    geom_segment(
      data = combined_preds %>%
        filter(switched),
      aes(
        x = 1,
        xend = 2,
        y = pred_gene,
        yend = pred_prot
      ),
      color = "grey40",
      linewidth = 1
    ) +

    # Gene predictions
    geom_point(
      aes(
        x = 1,
        y = pred_gene,
        color = LRTI_adjudication
      ),
      size = 2.8,
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +

    # Protein predictions
    geom_point(
      aes(
        x = 2,
        y = pred_prot,
        color = LRTI_adjudication
      ),
      size = 2.8,
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    
    # Classification threshold
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0.5,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "grey40",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +

    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Definite" = LRTI_color,
        "No Evidence" = control_color
      ),
      breaks = c(
        "Definite",
        "No Evidence"
      ),
      labels = c(
        "Definite" = "LRTI",
        "No Evidence" = "Control"
      )
    ) +

    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = c(1, 2),
      labels = c("Gene", "Protein"),
      limits = c(0.7, 2.3)
    ) +

    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 1),
      breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1)
    ) +

    facet_wrap(
      ~LRTI_adjudication,
      ncol = 2,
      labeller = labeller(
        LRTI_adjudication = facet_labels
      )
    ) +

    labs(
      title = paste0(
        classifier_name,
        " classifier predictions"
      ),
      x = NULL,
      y = "Predicted LRTI probability"
    ) +

    theme_classic(
      base_family = "Arial"
    ) +

    theme(
      text = element_text(
        family = "Arial",
        size = 14,
        face = "plain"
      ),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        family = "Arial",
        size = 16,
        color = "black",
        face = "plain"
      ),
      axis.text.y = element_text(
        family = "Arial",
        size = 16,
        color = "black",
        face = "plain"
      ),
      axis.title = element_text(
        family = "Arial",
        size = 16,
        face = "plain"
      ),
      strip.text = element_text(
        family = "Arial",
        size = 16,
        face = "plain"
      ),
      plot.title = element_text(
        family = "Arial",
        size = 16,
        face = "plain",
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      legend.position = "none"
    )


  # Save PDF
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(plots_dir, output_filename),
    plot = pred_shift_plot,
    width = 6.5,
    height = 6.5,
    device = cairo_pdf,
    bg = "white"
  )


  # Return the data and plot
  invisible(
    list(
      plot = pred_shift_plot,
      combined_preds = combined_preds,
      switched_patients = combined_preds %>%
        filter(switched)
    )
  )
}

# 5.9. Pairwise DeLong Comparisons Across All Classifiers


# Define all gene and protein classifiers
delong_classifiers <- classifier_files$classifier

# Start with shared patient IDs and outcomes
delong_data <- patient_info_with_folds %>%
  select(
    patient_id,
    LRTI_adjudication
  )

# Import predictions for each classifier
for (i in seq_along(delong_classifiers)) {

  classifier_name <- delong_classifiers[i]
  prediction_file <- classifier_files$csv[i]

  # Gene predictions
  gene_preds <- read.csv(
    file.path(gene_results_dir, prediction_file),
    stringsAsFactors=F
  ) %>%
    inner_join(
      patient_info_with_folds %>%
        select(sample_name, patient_id),
      by = "sample_name"
    ) %>%
    select(patient_id, pred)

  names(gene_preds)[2] <- paste0(
    "Gene: ",
    classifier_name
  )

  delong_data <- delong_data %>%
    left_join(
      gene_preds,
      by = "patient_id"
    )

  # Protein predictions
  prot_preds <- read.csv(
    file.path(prot_results_dir, prediction_file),
    stringsAsFactors=F
  ) %>%
    select(patient_id, pred)

  names(prot_preds)[2] <- paste0(
    "Protein: ",
    classifier_name
  )

  delong_data <- delong_data %>%
    left_join(
      prot_preds,
      by = "patient_id"
    )
}


# Keep the same patients across all classifiers
prediction_cols <- setdiff(
  names(delong_data),
  c("patient_id", "LRTI_adjudication")
)

delong_data <- delong_data[
  complete.cases(delong_data[, prediction_cols]),
]

# Define outcome levels
response <- factor(
  delong_data$LRTI_adjudication,
  levels = c("No Evidence", "Definite")
)

# Calculate ROC objects for all classifiers
roc_objects <- lapply(
  prediction_cols,
  function(classifier) {
    pROC::roc(
      response = response,
      predictor = delong_data[[classifier]],
      direction = "<",
      quiet = TRUE
    )
  }
)

names(roc_objects) <- prediction_cols


# Run all unique paired DeLong comparisons
classifier_pairs <- combn(
  prediction_cols,
  2,
  simplify = FALSE
)

delong_results <- bind_rows(
  lapply(classifier_pairs, function(pair) {

    test <- pROC::roc.test(
      roc_objects[[pair[1]]],
      roc_objects[[pair[2]]],
      paired = TRUE,
      method = "delong"
    )

    data.frame(
      Classifier_1 = pair[1],
      Classifier_2 = pair[2],
      p_value = test$p.value,
      stringsAsFactors=F
    )
  })
)

# Adjust for multiple comparisons
delong_results$p_adjusted_Holm <- p.adjust(
  delong_results$p_value,
  method = "holm"
)

# Print all pairwise results
delong_results <- delong_results %>%
  arrange(p_value)

print(
  delong_results,
  row.names=F
)
